description.value: Pizzeria Spacca Napoli is an authentic Neapolitan pizzeria in Port Moody founded in 2016 by Davide Di Giovanni and Danny Pero, built around a commitment to Italian tradition using imported 00 flour, DOP San Marzano tomatoes, and even European scissors for slicing pizza the Neapolitan way. In 2024 it was named the Best Neapolitan Pizzeria in Canada and became the first Canadian pizzeria to earn three 'spicchi' from Italy's prestigious Gambero Rosso guide. Cyclists will find a welcoming sit-down restaurant with pickup and delivery options, vegan-adaptable pizzas, and gluten-free pasta on the menu.

address.value: 2801 St. Johns Street, Port Moody, BC V3H 2C1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, award-winning Neapolitan pizzeria at 2801 St. Johns Street, Port Moody, matching the OSM address; the website adds the postal code V3H 2C1 and uses 'St.' rather than 'Saint'.
